entries.title: 중국인 학습자의 한국어 경음화 오류 분석을 통한 교육 방안 연구 - 인지와 산출의 상관성을 중심으로
entries.finding: Production and cognition experiments with 20 Chinese learners analysed errors in fortis (경음) realisation; authors recommend teaching lax vs fortis via closure duration and tension, and continuing fortis instruction at intermediate/advanced levels. Journal: 우리말글 73, pp.195-220. Abstract page only.

entries.title: 중국어의 자음을 역으로 활용한 중국어권 학습자의 한국어 자음의 발음 교정 방법에 대하여
entries.finding: Proposes combining contrastive analysis with experimental-phonetics data and using Chinese allophones in reverse to correct Korean consonants (plosives, affricates, fricatives, liquids). Journal 언어와 문화 6(3), KCI candidate. Abstract only; no specific error rates seen.

entries.title: Task Effects on Perceptual Learning of Korean Three-way Phoneme Distinction (한국어 삼중 음소 대립의 지각학습에 미치는 과제 효과)
entries.authors: authors not shown on fetched page; search snippet attributed it to 박성현, 박형생 (unverified)
entries.finding: Japanese learners trained on Korean alveolar stop three-way contrast: identification training gave the biggest gains; gains differed by phoneme, attributed to selective responses to VOT and F0 cues. Journal: Korean J. Cognitive and Biological Psychology 20(3), 145-166.

entries.title: 일본어 화자의 한국어 평음/기음/경음 지각 오류
entries.finding: 8 Japanese speakers: lenis vs the other two series was hardest; typical errors were lenis heard as aspirated and aspirated/fortis heard as lenis; explained by acoustic differences from Japanese voiceless stops. Journal: 언어청각장애연구 7(1), 166-180.

entries.title: 몽골어 파열음의 음향적 특성이 몽골인 한국어 수준별 학습자의 한국어 파열음에 대한 음성인식에 미치는 영향
entries.finding: 30 Mongolian learners (15 low, 15 high proficiency) had difficulty telling plain from aspirated Korean stops; author suggests reliance on VOT only in Mongolian weakens F0 sensitivity. 몽골학 67, 9-32. Abstract only.

entries.title: 숙달도와 거주 기간에 따른 베트남인 학습자의 발음 습득 양상 - 자음과 음운현상을 중심으로
entries.finding: Tense/aspirated triple contrast was problematic for Vietnamese learners; /ㅅ/ vs /ㅆ/ hardest; proficiency affected acquisition but length of stay did not. 이화어문논집 35, 143-172. Abstract only (sample size not seen).

entries.title: Schertz, Cho, Lotto & Warner (Journal of Phonetics, 2015) on Korean/English stop cues; Chang (2010) cited in Language and Speech 62(3) 2019, doi 10.1177/0023830918785649
entries.finding: Search-engine summary only (page returned 403 on fetch): English learners after 5 weeks of Korean varied, some using VOT+F0, some one cue only. NOT verified by me.

entries.title: Perception of Korean coda consonants by Chinese learners of Korean: A one-year longitudinal study
entries.finding: 21 beginner Chinese learners; coda perception improved over a year for /n,p,k,m/ but not /l, ŋ, t/; motivated by Mandarin permitting only /n, ŋ/ codas. Phonetics and Speech Sciences 8(4), 79-87.

entries.title: 중국인 한국어 학습자의 종성 발음 오류 연구 (Jeju National Univ. thesis)
entries.finding: Per search summary only (my fetch failed): omission is the most frequent error, esp. for stops ㄱ/ㄷ/ㅂ codas absent in L1. Not verified.

entries.title: Ewha thesis on Japanese speakers' errors in Korean final nasals
entries.finding: Search snippet only (fetch 403): errors tied to environments where Japanese moraic nasal /N/ appears. Not verified. Nothing found on unreleased stops for Japanese.

entries.title: 고립어권(중국·베트남) 한국어 학습자의 한국어 음운 변동 지각 습득 양상과 학습자 변인에 관한 연구
entries.finding: Vietnamese learners tended to keep underlying forms or mishandle final consonants and linking in connected speech; liquid/obstruent nasalisation acquired somewhat faster than by Chinese learners; linking and liquid assimilation near native-like by intermediate level. Korean Language Education Research 26, 191-223. Abstract only.

entries.title: 숙달도와 거주 기간에 따른 베트남인 학습자의 발음 습득 양상 - 자음과 음운현상을 중심으로
entries.finding: Nasalisation had the highest error rate among tested phenomena; in liaison, double final consonants produced more errors than single ones.

entries.title: 고립어권(중국·베트남) 한국어 학습자의 한국어 음운 변동 지각 습득 양상과 학습자 변인에 관한 연구
entries.finding: Chinese learners often replaced nasals with /ㄴ/ and heard aspirated/tense consonants as lax; aspiration and post-obstruent tensification stayed hard regardless of proficiency.

entries.title: 베트남인 초급 학습자의 한국어 유음 발음 양상에 대한 분석
entries.finding: 13 beginner learners: syllable-final /l/ most often replaced by [n]; initial /l/ sometimes replaced by [n],[ʐ],[j] or retroflexed; [n] substitution higher in function morphemes (을/를 59.6%). 이화어문논집 39, 49-87.

entries.title: 중국인 학습자들의 한국어 모음 습득 과정에 대한 1년간의 종단연구
entries.finding: Native naive listeners rated five Korean vowels from Chinese learners every 2 months for a year; learning trajectories differed by vowel according to L1-L2 mapping, with an early plateau. Abstract does not say which five vowels, so it does not confirm ㅓ/ㅗ/ㅡ/ㅜ results. 언어 36(4).
